in_sanskrit.name: धुर्बा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Dhurba is derived from the Sanskrit word धुर्बा (dhurba), which means rough, uneven, or bumpy. This name could be used for a child who is expected to face challenges and obstacles in life, or for one who is believed to have a rough or uneven character.

in_hindi.name: धुर्बा
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Dhurba is transliterated as धुर्बा (dhurba). The meaning of the name is 'ढूढ़ी' (dhuubhhaa), which means rough or uneven.

in_tamil.name: துர்பா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Dhurba is transliterated as துர்பா (thurbaa). The meaning of the name is 'துரையார்' (turaiyar), which means one who is rough or uneven.

in_telugu.name: ధుర్బ
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Dhurba is transliterated as ధుర్బ (dhurbhu). The meaning of the name is 'ధుర్బ' (dhurbhu), which means rough or uneven.
